#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

class BufferedInput {
public:
    std::istream& in;
    std::vector<char> buf;
    int idx;
    int len;

    BufferedInput(std::istream& is) : in(is), buf(1024), idx(0), len(0) {}

    int readByte() {
        if (len == -1) throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (idx >= len) {
            idx = 0;
            in.read(buf.data(), buf.size());
            len = in.gcount();
            if (len <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return static_cast<unsigned char>(buf[idx++]);
    }

    int readInteger() {
        int c = readByte();
        while (isSpace(c)) c = readByte();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = readByte();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = readByte();
        } while (!isSpace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

    bool isSpace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class Algorithm {
public:
    static const int MAX_LEN = 1 << 20;
    std::vector<double> cCos;
    std::vector<double> cSin;
    std::vector<double> cConjCos;
    std::vector<double> cConjSin;

    Algorithm() : cCos(MAX_LEN), cSin(MAX_LEN), cConjCos(MAX_LEN), cConjSin(MAX_LEN) {
        for (int size = 1; size <= cCos.size(); size <<= 1) {
            int half = size >> 1;
            for (int i = half; i < size; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * (i - half) / size;
                cCos[i] = cos(angle);
                cSin[i] = sin(angle);
                cConjCos[i] = cos(-angle);
                cConjSin[i] = sin(-angle);
            }
        }
    }

    void run(int testIdx, BufferedInput& reader, std::ostream& writer) {
        const int MOD = 998244353;
        int n = reader.readInteger();
        int k = reader.readInteger();
        std::vector<int> baseVector(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int idx = reader.readInteger();
            baseVector[idx] = 1;
        }

        std::vector<int> currentResult = {1};
        int exp = n / 2;

        while (true) {
            if ((exp & 1) != 0) {
                currentResult = polyMultiply(currentResult, baseVector, MOD);
            }
            exp >>= 1;
            if (exp == 0) break;
            baseVector = polyMultiply(baseVector, baseVector, MOD);
        }

        long long sum = 0;
        for (int x : currentResult) {
            sum += (long long)x * x;
        }
        writer << sum % MOD << std::endl;
    }

    std::vector<int> polyMultiply(const std::vector<int>& A, const std::vector<int>& B, int mod) {
        int requiredLen = A.size() + B.size() - 1;
        int n = std::max(2, (int)std::pow(2, std::ceil(std::log2(requiredLen))));

        std::vector<double> ar(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> ai(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)A.size(); i++) {
            int val = ((A[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            ar[i] = val & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            ai[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        transform(ar, ai, false);

        std::vector<double> br(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> bi(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)B.size(); i++) {
            int val = ((B[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            br[i] = val & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            bi[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        transform(br, bi, false);

        std::vector<double> cr(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> ci(n, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
            double a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
            double a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;

            double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
            double b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;

            cr[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            ci[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        }

        transform(cr, ci, true);
        std::vector<int> output(requiredLen);
        for (int i = 0; i < requiredLen; i++) {
            long long p = std::llround(cr[i]);
            long long q = std::llround(ci[i]);
            long long r = std::llround(ci[n - i]);
            output[i] = (int)((p + ((q % mod) << 15) + ((r % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return output;
    }

    void transform(std::vector<double>& real, std::vector<double>& imag, bool isInverse) {
        int n = real.size();
        int bits = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_reverse(i) >> (32 - bits);
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(real[i], real[j]);
                std::swap(imag[i], imag[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            int step = cCos.size() / len;

            for (int base = 0; base < n; base += len) {
                for (int offset = 0, wIdx = 0; offset < half; offset++, wIdx += step) {
                    double wReal = isInverse ? cConjCos[half + offset] : cCos[half + offset];
                    double wImag = isInverse ? cConjSin[half + offset] : cSin[half + offset];

                    int idx1 = base + offset;
                    int idx2 = base + offset + half;

                    double uRe = real[idx1];
                    double uIm = imag[idx1];
                    double vRe = real[idx2] * wReal - imag[idx2] * wImag;
                    double vIm = real[idx2] * wImag + imag[idx2] * wReal;

                    real[idx1] = uRe + vRe;
                    imag[idx1] = uIm + vIm;
                    real[idx2] = uRe - vRe;
                    imag[idx2] = uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }

        if (isInverse) {
            double invN = 1.0 / n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                real[i] *= invN;
                imag[i] *= invN;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    BufferedInput in(std::cin);
    std::ostream& out = std::cout;
    Algorithm alg;
    alg.run(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
